# HarborBridge candidate overview — synthetic
Evaluation type: local retrieval-and-citation prototype sample, 50 questions each. Run identifiers are maple-17 and birch-23. Their answer claims require separate evidence verification.
Maple (maple-17): retrieval_recall_at_5 = 46/50; p95_latency_ms = 91.
Birch (birch-23): retrieval_recall_at_5 = 48/50; p95_latency_ms = 77.
Retrieval recall is document retrieval coverage, not citation correctness or full-answer accuracy. This table does not report costs, throughput, production deployment, or end-to-end correctness.
